files.content: # frozen_string_literal: true module RubyUI # A round image with a text fallback, like shadcn's Avatar. The size is # exposed as data-size so the parts (fallback text, badge) follow it. class Avatar < Base SIZES = { xs: "size-4", sm: "size-6", default: "size-8", lg: "size-10", xl: "size-20" }.freeze # :md was the default before RubyUI matched shadcn's size names. ALIASES = {md: :default}.freeze def initialize(size: :default, **attrs) @size = size.to_s.to_sym @size = ALIASES.fetch(@size, @size) @size = :default unless SIZES.key?(@size) # nil or unknown: default size super(**attrs) end def view_template(&) span(**attrs, &) end private def default_attrs { data: { slot: "avatar", size: @size, controller: "ruby-ui--avatar" }, class: [ "group/avatar relative flex shrink-0 select-none rounded-full", "after:absolute after:inset-0 after:rounded-full after:border after:border-border after:mix-blend-darken dark:after:mix-blend-lighten", # The root doesn't clip (the badge sits on its edge), so a plain # child (instead of AvatarImage) is sized and rounded here. "*:[img]:size-full *:[img]:rounded-full *:[img]:object-cover", SIZES.fetch(@size) ] } end end end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # A dot (or a small icon) on the avatar's bottom-right corner, e.g. an
  # online status. Its size follows the avatar's size; on :xs and :sm the
  # icon is hidden and only the dot shows.
  class AvatarBadge < Base
    def view_template(&)
      span(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "avatar-badge"},
        class: [
          "absolute right-0 bottom-0 z-10 inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-blend-color ring-2 select-none",
          "bg-primary text-primary-foreground ring-background",
          "group-data-[size=xs]/avatar:size-1.5 group-data-[size=xs]/avatar:[&>svg]:hidden",
          "group-data-[size=sm]/avatar:size-2 group-data-[size=sm]/avatar:[&>svg]:hidden",
          "group-data-[size=default]/avatar:size-2.5 group-data-[size=default]/avatar:[&>svg]:size-2",
          "group-data-[size=lg]/avatar:size-3 group-data-[size=lg]/avatar:[&>svg]:size-2",
          "group-data-[size=xl]/avatar:size-5 group-data-[size=xl]/avatar:[&>svg]:size-3"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Shown while the image loads, when it fails, or when there is no image.
  # delay: (ms) waits before showing it, so a fast image doesn't flash the
  # initials first (Base UI's Avatar.Fallback delay).
  class AvatarFallback < Base
    def initialize(delay: nil, **attrs)
      @delay = delay
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      span(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def delay? = @delay.to_i.positive?

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {
          slot: "avatar-fallback",
          ruby_ui__avatar_target: "fallback",
          delay: @delay
        },
        # With a delay, start hidden so it can't paint before the controller
        # connects (the controller removes the attribute and runs the timer).
        hidden: delay?,
        class: [
          "flex size-full items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-muted text-sm text-muted-foreground",
          "group-data-[size=xs]/avatar:text-[0.5rem] group-data-[size=sm]/avatar:text-xs group-data-[size=xl]/avatar:text-base",
          # Before the controller connects (or without JS) an image that is
          # still visible wins: the fallback stays out of the way.
          "group-has-[[data-slot=avatar-image]:not(.hidden)]/avatar:hidden"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Overlapping avatars, each ringed in the background color. End it with an
  # AvatarGroupCount for the "+N" bubble.
  class AvatarGroup < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "avatar-group"},
        class: "group/avatar-group flex -space-x-2 *:data-[slot=avatar]:ring-2 *:data-[slot=avatar]:ring-background"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The "+N" bubble at the end of an AvatarGroup. It takes the size of the
  # group's avatars.
  class AvatarGroupCount < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "avatar-group-count"},
        class: [
          "relative flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-muted text-sm text-muted-foreground ring-2 ring-background [&>svg]:size-4",
          "group-has-data-[size=xs]/avatar-group:size-4 group-has-data-[size=xs]/avatar-group:text-[0.5rem] group-has-data-[size=xs]/avatar-group:[&>svg]:size-2",
          "group-has-data-[size=sm]/avatar-group:size-6 group-has-data-[size=sm]/avatar-group:text-xs group-has-data-[size=sm]/avatar-group:[&>svg]:size-3",
          "group-has-data-[size=lg]/avatar-group:size-10 group-has-data-[size=lg]/avatar-group:[&>svg]:size-5",
          "group-has-data-[size=xl]/avatar-group:size-20 group-has-data-[size=xl]/avatar-group:text-base group-has-data-[size=xl]/avatar-group:[&>svg]:size-8"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class AvatarImage < Base
    def initialize(src:, alt: "", **attrs)
      @src = src
      @alt = alt
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template
      img(**attrs)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        # NB: do not set loading: "lazy" here. avatar_controller hides a not-yet-loaded
        # image with `display:none` (the `hidden` class) so the fallback shows. The
        # browser never fetches a `loading="lazy"` image that generates no box, so its
        # `load` event never fires and the image stays hidden forever (#415). shadcn/radix
        # do not lazy-load the avatar image either.
        data: {
          slot: "avatar-image",
          ruby_ui__avatar_target: "image",
          action: "load->ruby-ui--avatar#showImage error->ruby-ui--avatar#showFallback"
        },
        class: "aspect-square size-full rounded-full object-cover",
        alt: @alt,
        src: @src
      }
    end
  end
end

docs_markdown:
# Avatar

An image element with a fallback for representing the user.

## Usage

### Image & fallback

```ruby
Avatar do
  AvatarImage(src: "https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/246692?v=4", alt: "joeldrapper")
  AvatarFallback { "JD" }
end
```

### Only fallback

```ruby
Avatar do
  AvatarFallback { "JD" }
end
```

### Sizes

```ruby
div(class: "flex items-center gap-4") do
  [:xs, :sm, :default, :lg, :xl].each do |size|
    Avatar(size: size) do
      AvatarImage(src: "https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/246692?v=4", alt: "joeldrapper")
      AvatarFallback { "JD" }
    end
  end
end
```

### Sizes (only fallback)

```ruby
div(class: "flex items-center gap-4") do
  [:xs, :sm, :default, :lg, :xl].each do |size|
    Avatar(size: size) do
      AvatarFallback { "JD" }
    end
  end
end
```

### Badge

```ruby
Avatar do
  AvatarImage(src: "https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/246692?v=4", alt: "joeldrapper")
  AvatarFallback { "JD" }
  AvatarBadge(class: "bg-green-600 dark:bg-green-800")
end
```

### Group

```ruby
AvatarGroup do
  Avatar do
    AvatarImage(src: "https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/246692?v=4", alt: "joeldrapper")
    AvatarFallback { "JD" }
  end
  Avatar do
    AvatarFallback { "CN" }
  end
  Avatar do
    AvatarFallback { "RU" }
  end
  AvatarGroupCount { "+3" }
end
```

### Fallback delay

```ruby
Avatar do
  AvatarImage(src: "https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/246692?v=4", alt: "joeldrapper")
  AvatarFallback(delay: 600) { "JD" }
end
```
